title: centromere_table_ingest_v1 — manifest contract for the quarTeT / centromics centromere TSV
description: Validates POST /api/actions when type='centromere_table_ingest'. Resolves a `df_centromeres_*.tsv` (per-chrom centromere coordinates + TR/TE coverage) from the workspace and emits a centromeres_table_v0 envelope.

path.description: Workspace-relative path to the centromere TSV.

subject.description: Optional tag for the assembly the centromere coordinates describe (e.g. 'fClaHyb_Gar').
